title: Pepper Steak with Onions
seoTitle: Pepper Steak with Onions | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Sliced round steak with bell peppers over rice for ten
subtitle: Sliced round steak with bell peppers over rice for ten
description: Round steak strips marinate in soy and ginger, stir-fry with peppers and onions, and finish in a savory gravy. Serve over steamed rice for a filling hall plate.

steps.title: Marinate and prep rice
steps.instruction: Toss sliced steak with half the soy sauce and ginger. Start rice in a pot with 6 cups water—bring to boil, cover, simmer 18 minutes, then rest off heat.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry beef in batches 2–3 minutes until browned but still tender. Set aside.

steps.title: Stir-fry vegetables
steps.instruction: Add peppers and onion to the wok. Stir-fry 4–5 minutes until charred at edges and slightly softened.

steps.title: Build the gravy
steps.instruction: Stir remaining soy sauce, garlic, broth, and cornstarch slurry into the wok. Simmer 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.instruction: Return beef and juices to gravy, toss 1 minute to coat. Fluff rice and serve pepper steak over rice at the line.

proTips: A splash of rice vinegar at the end brightens heavy soy gravy.
Use baking soda pinch in marinade for extra tender beef if your cut is tough.
Sesame oil drizzle at service adds aroma—do not cook it on high heat.
tonightSpread: Pepper steak over rice with steamed broccoli on the side.
Chili garlic crisp at the table for crew who want more heat.
leftovers: Wrap in flour tortillas with extra sauce for quick lunch wraps.
Stir into fried rice the next day with scrambled eggs.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Pepper steak delivers big savory flavor with ingredients already in the station pantry. Rice stretches the protein and keeps everyone full through a second call.
mealPrepNotes: Slice steak against the grain paper-thin. Mix gravy slurry before you start cooking—no time to measure mid-stir-fry. Cook rice in a separate pot or rice cooker.
